children: Postal Realty Trust reported third-quarter 2026 net income attributable to common shareholders of $5.6 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, and AFFO of $0.36 per diluted share. Revenue rose 24.5% year over year to $30.3 million, while operating income increased to $11.9 million. The company raised its 2026 AFFO per-share guidance to $1.42–$1.44.
Total revenue was $30.3 million, compared with $24.3 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Operating income was $11.9 million, up from $9.1 million a year earlier.
Net income attributable to common shareholders was $5.6 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, compared with $3.8 million, or $0.13 per diluted share, in the prior-year quarter.
AFFO was $13.9 million, or $0.36 per diluted share, representing 9.1% year-over-year growth per share. FFO was $14.0 million, or $0.36 per diluted share.
The company increased 2026 AFFO guidance to $1.42–$1.44 per diluted share and acquisition-volume guidance to $185 million–$200 million.
The portfolio comprised 2,159 properties across 49 states and one territory, with approximately 7.9 million net leasable interior square feet and 99.8% occupancy.
Postal Realty acquired 145 USPS-leased last-mile and flex properties during the quarter, adding approximately 387,000 net leasable interior square feet.
Rental income increased 25.2% year over year, reflecting internal growth and acquisitions.

The company reported a 3.5x pro forma net debt-to-run-rate adjusted EBITDA ratio and said 93% of debt was fixed, including the effect of interest-rate hedges. It also secured a BBB investment-grade rating from Fitch.
Postal Realty announced a quarterly dividend of $0.245 per share, payable November 27, 2026, to stockholders of record on November 13.
